outputs.explanation: Panel A shows spatial heat-map images of cell deconvolution scores overlaid on tissue sections, not a plot of averaged/summary statistics, so individual data points are not applicable.

The box plots quantifying immune cell fractions have individual data points (dots for each spatial spot/biological replicate) overlaid on the boxes, satisfying the requirement to show underlying data behind the summary statistics.
The GSEA enrichment plots display a running enrichment score curve with NES/FDR/P statistics; this is not a plot of an average value across replicates, so there are no individual data points to show.

The bar graph shows a single derived log2 fold-change value per gene from the differential expression analysis (with associated p-value), not a mean computed from a small set of discrete replicate measurements, so individual data points are not required.
Panel E consists of representative H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot showing averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.
